IC1.IC1.1: Participants must present a diagnosis of osteoporosis
IC1.IC1.3: measurement of the bone mineral density
IC1.IC1.6: and/or lumbar spine (T value 2.5 SD or more below the young female adult mean) within the past 24 months.

IC2.IC2.2: ot in treatment with anti-resorptive agents (like bisphosphonates
IC2.IC2.3: and denosumab) for more than 4 consecutive years, in order to reduce the risk of medication-related osteonecrosis of the jaws (Lo et al., 2010).

IC.IC4: In self-reported menopause, defined as the permanent cessation of ovulation, for at least one year (Soules et al., 2001).
IC.IC5: Edentulous area involving a maximum of two teeth (wisdom teeth and second molars are excluded) and presenting at least one neighbouring tooth (e.g. gap in the area of a second premolar and first molar, with first premolar in place).
IC.IC6: Residual alveolar width = 4 mm (Milinkovic and Cordaro, 2014), residual alveolar height >8 mm, enough inter-arch space for a crown (at least 5 mm) and a minimum distance of 7 mm from the adjacent teeth (Shah and Lum, 2008). The width and height will be confirmed after x-ray examination in Visit 2.
IC.IC7: Possibility to restore a functional occlusion with a minimum of four occlusal units (i.e. pairs of occluding posterior teeth).
IC.IC8: Willingness to replace the missing tooth/teeth with dental implants
